none: PAS NLM-68E59F: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Probably a nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), if so, probably a Constantinopolis commemorative issue of330-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: [bust] probably left. Obverse inscription: [CON]STAN[TINOPOLIS]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left; vertical branch in left field. Diameter: 14.3mm, Weight: 0.97gms, die axis: probably 12
